display.summary: ScanLink scanner support moves into DjangoLux and stays off until you switch it on.
highlights: ScanLink is opt-in per system, under the new Extra Features settings step.
Publish scanner installers from Options; they are served only to signed-in users.
Import a configuration file into System Settings and review every change before applying.
Admin panel actions are usable on phone-width screens.
Setup wizard step buttons now open the step they name.
